```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import create_engine

load_dotenv()
```

```{python}
data_dir = Path(os.environ["DATA_DIR"])
csv_path = data_dir / "construction_permits" / "Residential_Construction_Permits_by_County_6297027898887955680.csv"
```

```{python}
df_raw = pd.read_csv(
    csv_path,
    dtype = {"STATE": str, "COUNTY": str, "GEOID": str, "OBJECTID": str}
)
```

```{python}
# make sure all column names are lowercase
def lower_cols(df):
    df.columns = df.columns.str.lower()
    return df
df_raw = lower_cols(df_raw)
```

### Data Transformations
- Concatonate state and county coulumns to create county_id
    - Drop state and county cols 
- Standardize the column naming format to help wide to long operation later
- Convert from wide to long format by creating year column
- Drop objectid, geoid, name, stusab, state_name, shape__area, shape__length

```{python}
df_raw = df_raw.rename(columns= {"multifamily_permits_3_4_unit_2022": "multifamily_permits_3_4_units_2022", "multifamily_permits_5_or_more_2022": "multifamily_permits_5_or_more_units_2022"})
```

```{python}
# convert from wide to long format, creating year column in the process
id_vars = [
    'objectid', 'geoid', 'state', 'county', 'name', 'stusab', 
    'state_name', 'shape__area', 'shape__length'
]

stubnames = [
    'all_permits_', 
    'single_family_permits_', 
    'all_multifamily_permits_',
    'multifamily_permits_2_units_', 
    'multifamily_permits_3_4_units_',
    'multifamily_permits_5_or_more_units_'
]

df_raw = pd.wide_to_long(
    df_raw, 
    stubnames=stubnames, 
    i=id_vars, 
    j='year', 
    sep='',
    suffix=r'\d\d\d\d'
).reset_index()
```

```{python}
# combind state and county fips codes to create county_id column
df_raw["county_id"] = df_raw["state"] + df_raw["county"]
df_raw = df_raw.drop(columns=["state", "county"])
```

```{python}
# drop extra cols
df_raw = df_raw.drop(columns=["shape__area", "shape__length", "objectid", "name", "stusab", "state_name", "geoid"])
```

```{python}
# reorder columns to put county_id first
df_final = df_raw[['county_id', 'year', 'all_permits_', 'single_family_permits_',
       'all_multifamily_permits_', 'multifamily_permits_2_units_',
       'multifamily_permits_3_4_units_',
       'multifamily_permits_5_or_more_units_']]
```

```{python}
# remove tailing "_" from column names
df_final.columns = df_final.columns.str.rstrip('_')
```

```{python}
# remapping Oglala Lakota County code to fips standard
df_final.loc[df_final["county_id"] == "46113", "county_id"] = "46102"
```

```{python}
# remove years outside of analysis window
def trim_years(df):
    df = df[df["year"] >= 2001]
    df = df[df["year"] <= 2022]
    return df

df_final = trim_years(df_final)
```

```{python}
database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
engine = create_engine(database_url)
```

```{python}
# export cleaned data to sql table in local db
df_final.to_sql(
    "res_construction_permits",
    con=engine,
    if_exists="replace",
    index=False
)
```
